CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: DEL-17-07-REQ-012: the target version basis shall remain TBD until public evidence or human project authority selects a first PCF target profile.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: DEL-17-07-REQ-013: the profile shall classify each candidate entity family as exported, omitted, approximated, delegated, unsupported, or TBD.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: DEL-17-07-REQ-014: the initial candidate subset shall be limited to the plan-listed PCF entities and attributes unless later source review narrows or expands it.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: DEL-17-07-REQ-015: the PCF profile shall carry DEL-17-01, DEL-17-02, CAEPIPE-PCF, and PLAN-EXPORT-INTEROP source-basis references; missing references shall block package acceptance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: DEL-17-07-REQ-020: the PCF writer shall emit only profile-supported content from unit-aware, provenance-bearing OpenPipeStress model data.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: DEL-17-07-REQ-021: the writer shall produce diagnostics for missing or ambiguous units, coordinates, nominal size, OD, wall thickness, material/spec labels, component identity, end-connection data, and support/restraint semantics when those fields affect the selected profile.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: DEL-17-07-REQ-022: the writer shall not invent pressure, temperature, fluid density, component weight, OD, wall thickness, material properties, support type, equipment connection, or boundary-condition data.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: DEL-17-07-REQ-023: the writer shall preserve canonical OpenPipeStress identity through target metadata when explicitly supported or through a sidecar stable ID map when direct PCF carriage is not source-confirmed.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: DEL-17-07-REQ-024: the writer shall record target-generated identity separately from canonical OpenPipeStress identity.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: DEL-17-07-REQ-030: every PCF export attempt shall produce or reference a loss report.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: DEL-17-07-REQ-031: loss report entries shall include affected canonical IDs, category, severity, target artifact if any, reason, source-basis reference, and downstream implication, consistent with DEL-17-02.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: DEL-17-07-REQ-032: support/restraint semantics shall be listed separately when the PCF target path cannot preserve them reliably.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: DEL-17-07-REQ-033: free-end, equipment-nozzle, adjacent-pipeline, and boundary-condition semantics shall be blocked, TBD, delegated, or loss-reported when the target path would otherwise depend on translator anchoring or incomplete PCF connection data.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: DEL-17-07-REQ-034: component mappings known to become target-side rigid elements, equivalent pipes, concentrated masses, or other approximations shall be recorded as approximated or delegated behavior rather than direct support.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: DEL-17-07-REQ-040: fixtures shall be invented or otherwise redistribution-safe with documented provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: DEL-17-07-REQ-041: fixtures shall not copy proprietary plant models, vendor examples, protected standards text, protected tables, material allowables, SIF/flexibility values, owner criteria, or commercial catalog values.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: DEL-17-07-REQ-042: public fixtures shall avoid code-specific compliance semantics and shall not imply professional acceptance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Public CAEPIPE PCF translator documentation (CAEPIPE-PCF) is an accessible source for translator behavior, defaults, and mappings, but not authority for OpenPipeStress completeness or compatibility claims.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: The PCF format specification status is TBD; no redistributed proprietary specification text is admitted in this phase.

UnitStatement: Source-authority verification reviews that each PCF behavior statement cites DEL-17-01, DEL-17-02, PLAN-EXPORT-INTEROP, CAEPIPE-PCF, or project governance sources.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Units/coordinates verification: future tests shall include explicit unit-bearing source data and ambiguous/missing-unit negative cases, profile-bound to declared PCF unit representation, coordinate policy, rejection/diagnostic for missing/ambiguous unit metadata, and no dimensionless fallback for unit-bearing physical values.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Stable-ID verification: future tests shall verify sidecar identity mapping when direct PCF identity carriage is not source-confirmed.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Loss-report verification: future tests shall assert entries for omitted, approximated, delegated, unsupported, and TBD behavior.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Boundary-controls verification reviews for absence of proprietary examples, protected standards data, release claims, compatibility claims, code-compliance claims, and professional-acceptance claims.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Acceptance hook (coordinates/vertical axis): profile-declared coordinate/vertical-axis policy with diagnostic when source coordinate basis is absent or ambiguous.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Acceptance hook (nominal size, OD, wall thickness): export only explicit/source-confirmed attributes where selected; external mapping-database behavior is delegated or loss-reported.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Acceptance hook (material/spec labels): labels emitted only with source-owned provenance; target material-property mapping delegated unless source-confirmed.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.
